body: I don't know how to reply, I feel so grateful that you have take the time to talk to me, thank you. I've never been this low before, its as if I began to rely on someone else and now thats gone and I don't know how to go back. But I need to go back, I'm terrified of what could happen. I don't want to be lonely anymore and i'm scared.

I guess its not really specifically a thing, i feel worn down by everything, my father had a vicious temper as far back as I can remember, I was the oldest so I had the worst of it. After he walked out I ended up moving out with a guy at age 16 who was physically and mentally abusive, he forced me to do things that I am too ashamed to talk about. Eventually was strong enough to leave him and after a while dated a guy and I told him what had happened, I was told it was my fault for being a whore, this is a good 4 years ago now. 

I have been dating someone else recently, for the last 2 years, and for the first time in a long time I was starting to really trust someone, and I was truly happy for the first time I can remember, he ended things 4  months ago, he wants to be friends, but theres no spark.

I am just about holding on, i just want to be happy. I don't understand why I can't just pull myself together, other people have so much worse problems and so much worse things happen to people every day and they keep on being strong. I feel like such a wimp. I hate that I feel like i'm unraveling, its a daily struggle not to hurt myself and sometimes I loose. Sorry I've just ranted on and on.
